name: Research
description: Conducts comprehensive market research, competitive analysis, and data-driven insights to inform strategic decision-making

roles.name: Research Manager
roles.description: Leads research initiatives and develops comprehensive research strategies to support business decisions
responsibilities: Develop comprehensive research strategies and methodologies
Conduct primary and secondary research on market trends
Monitor and analyze competitor activities and strategies
Create comprehensive research reports and presentations

roles.name: Market Researcher
roles.description: Conducts market research and analyzes customer behavior to identify opportunities
responsibilities: Conduct market research and customer behavior analysis
Identify emerging trends and predict future market developments
Deep dive into customer needs, preferences, and pain points
Analyze market opportunities and competitive positioning

roles.name: Competitive Intelligence Analyst
roles.description: Monitors and analyzes competitor activities to inform strategic decisions
responsibilities: Monitor and analyze competitor activities and strategies
Conduct competitive analysis and benchmarking studies
Evaluate new technologies and their potential business impact
Provide competitive intelligence insights to support strategic planning

plan.prompt: Develop a comprehensive research strategy to support business decision-making and strategic planning.
Conduct market research and customer analysis based on the research strategy.
Analyze competitive landscape and provide intelligence insights to support the research strategy.
Synthesize research findings into actionable insights and strategic recommendations.
